name: ai/local-inference/status
description: Query Continuum's local inference HTTP server (Anthropic-compatible Messages API). Returns whether the server is running and the URL external agents (Claude Code via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, future Codex via OPENAI_BASE_URL) should point at to use local Continuum models instead of cloud APIs. First-class surface for the AGENT-BACKBONE integration story (PR #976 §1-§4).

results.name: running
results.description: True if the local inference HTTP server is bound + accepting requests

results.name: url
results.description: Base URL to use for external-agent ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL injection (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:8421). Empty when running=false.

results.name: port
results.description: TCP port the server is bound to. 0 when running=false.

results.name: protocol
results.description: Wire protocol the server speaks. Currently always 'anthropic' (Messages API). 'openai' will be added when openai_compat.rs lands per AGENT-BACKBONE §4.1.

examples.description: Check if local inference is up
